title: SS27 Women's Formalwear Styling
summary: Formal SS27 means the skirt suit, the cinched jacket and tailoring made light: knee-length skirts, peplum jackets, gold with a trench and organza suits for heat.

sections.heading: The runway looks
sections.body:
Chanel's narrow, knee-length skirts in smocked tweed and sheer organza<sup>[1]</sup> and its new tweed suit<sup>[2]</sup> set the tone for formal dressing. Givenchy showed cinched peplum tailoring, trench riffs and woollen overcoats<sup>[1]</sup>; Armani, Gucci and Jil Sander cinched jackets at the waist, and Jil Sander, Tod's and Marni shortened them<sup>[2]</sup>. Saint Laurent paired gold pencil skirts with trench coats<sup>[3]</sup>. For heat, Dior made organza tailoring printed to look like wool suiting<sup>[1]</sup>.

Sarah Burton described her Givenchy wardrobe as one "to bring precision and simplicity to dressing"<sup>[1]</sup>.

sections.heading: Formulas
sections.body:
- **Skirt suit.** A cropped, waisted jacket with a matching knee-length straight skirt.
- **Peplum jacket + slim trouser.** For the office; the waist is defined, the trouser stays straight.
- **Trench + pencil skirt.** A light trench over a satin or metallic pencil skirt.
- **Organza suit.** A summer suit in printed or plain organza over a slip, for weddings and day events in heat.
- **Shirt + full midi skirt + belt.** A poplin shirt tucked into a layered midi skirt, cinched with a leather belt.

design_implications:
- Cut skirt suits as separates sold together, so customers can buy different sizes top and bottom.
- Use cool wool, double crepe and organza to keep formalwear wearable in summer.
- Specify linings and finishing carefully: formal pieces are judged on the inside as much as the outside.
commercial_implications:
- Skirt suits replace part of the trouser-suit buy this season.
- Offer alteration-friendly seam allowances on skirts and jackets for a better fit at full price.
